name: Estranged Family
storyline: Estranged Family is a spin-off story of Friendship Test, set in the same universe and connected to it. In it, you will yourself on a mysterious planet with a found family that has been through many hardships. The family lands must learn how to begin their new lives here, but there is only one problem: you have no idea what's going on, how you got here or how you're supposed to feel. Help the main character, Star, figure out their role in this family, make choices that might improve your relationship with them or maybe completely disappoint them.
